documentOwnership.rule: The Markdown document is the human normative source. This JSON is its machine-readable mirror. Divergence between the two is a contract violation enforced by tests/portfolio-stress-model-contract.test.js.
documentOwnership.agentsMdEvidence: No AGENTS.md and no CLAUDE.md exist anywhere in Fede-ai-coder/apex-trading at base commit c226f5f2dd865c38ebcf7efef855a8437c4c6a35 (`git ls-files | grep -iE 'AGENTS|CLAUDE'` returns nothing). The repository has no single canonical development-rules document; its established convention is one topic-scoped contract document per subject at the repository root (BACKEND_DIRECTIONAL_SCANNER_CONTRACT.md, PORTFOLIO_OPTION_ENRICHMENT_CONTRACT.md, BACKEND_VIX_FAMILY_LIVE_CONTRACT.md, ...) plus an enforcing contract test under tests/. This specification follows that existing convention instead of introducing a second, competing instruction document.

hashIdentity.cssNote: No css/ directory is tracked at the base commit; all styling lives inline in index.html. The css/** byte-identity requirement is therefore satisfied over an empty set and is asserted as such rather than silently skipped.

monolithBoundary.forbiddenTokenMatching: case-sensitive literal substring; every token was verified to have ZERO occurrences in index.html and js/** at the base commit. Case-sensitivity is deliberate: index.html legitimately contains the prose 'Black-Scholes' inside AI-prompt strings that FORBID estimation, and the classifier identifier 'vixStressFlag'. Neither is a runtime stress-test surface, and neither matches any token above.

legLiveGreeks.scale: per share, unscaled by quantity or multiplier

deltaAndThetaNormalization.rule: a finite value with 0 < |n| <= 1 is multiplied by 100; otherwise returned unchanged
deltaAndThetaNormalization.consequence: Portfolio delta/theta totals are expressed in POINTS (delta 0.45 becomes 45), while gamma and vega stay raw. This is a heuristic on magnitude, not a declared unit, and it is idempotent only for |n| > 1.

positionScalarGreeks.evidence: computeRowBetaWeightedDelta (index.html:19088) header comment: 'pos.delta is the net position delta already shown in the row ... used AS-IS and NEVER re-scaled by quantity here'.

contractMultiplier.detail: No contractMultiplier field is carried on portfolio legs at the base commit. The 100x factor appears only inside the unrealized-P&L helper as a literal derived from leg type (option -> 100, equity -> 1). The stress contract therefore requires an explicit contractMultiplier on every hypothetical leg and an explicitly resolved multiplier for every actual leg.
contractMultiplier.evidence: index.html:18907 region — 'mult = 100 for option legs (1 contract = 100 shares), 1 for equity'; only three textual occurrences of 'multiplier' exist in index.html and none is a leg field.

units.applicationRule: Quantity and multiplier MUST be applied exactly once. A stress result MUST declare, per input field, whether the value it consumed was per-share, per-contract or already net.

hits.detail: A route-local closure inside GET /eic/legs/:symbol. It computes ONLY a Black-Scholes d1 delta with an Abramowitz & Stegun normal-CDF approximation. It is not exported, not on any module boundary, and grep over the whole repository finds ZERO call sites (`grep -n 'approxDelta' server.js` returns only the declaration line). It also references an undefined identifier `dteDay` on lines 6644 and 6645 while its parameter is named `dteDays`, so invoking it would throw ReferenceError. It has no test.

portfolioReactivityAudit.question: Why is the current Portfolio sufficiently reactive?
portfolioReactivityAudit.answerBasis: measured from source, not from visual perception

requestsPerRefreshCycle.detail: POST /portfolio/live-refresh carries ALL positions, ALL underlying symbols and ALL option streamer symbols in one body and returns underlyings + options + positions in one response.
requestsPerRefreshCycle.technicalRefresh: 0 or 1 (POST /portfolio/technical-refresh, plus at most 1 targeted retry for missing tickers)
requestsPerRefreshCycle.perSymbolFallbacks: 0 in the healthy path — /scanner, /market/live/:symbol, /market/quotes and fetchCandles are reached only when the batch response left a symbol unresolved

whyItIsFast: The backend holds a single persistent DXLink WebSocket and serves quotes/Greeks from in-memory Maps (quoteCache, greeksCache, optionQuoteCache) rather than fetching per request.
POST /portfolio/live-refresh deduplicates symbols into a Set before subscribing (underlyingSet / optionSet, server.js:11046-11047), so N legs on the same contract cost one subscription.
The route runs under an explicit server budget (LIVE_REFRESH_MAX_SERVER_MS) with per-phase timings published as liveRefreshPhaseTimings, so a slow phase degrades rather than blocking.

All portfolio Greek aggregation, beta-weighted delta and risk metrics are pure in-memory frontend functions over data already in hand — no network inside aggregateGreeks or computePortfolioRiskMetrics.
A storm circuit breaker (_backendCircuitOpen) suppresses per-symbol live fan-out entirely while the backend is unreachable.
portfolioReactivityAudit.implicationForStress: The stress endpoint MUST reproduce this shape: ONE batch request carrying every scenario, hydrating each exact contract at most once per run. Any per-cell, per-leg or per-scenario request would be strictly worse than the pattern the Portfolio already proves works.

contracts.title: Inventory before design
contracts.text: Every future responsibility MUST appear in the Reuse Manifest before it is assigned to a module.

contracts.title: Single canonical owner
contracts.text: Every responsibility MUST have exactly one canonical owner.

contracts.title: No copied implementation
contracts.text: An existing function MUST NOT be copied, transcribed or rewritten under a new name.

contracts.title: Thin delegation only
contracts.text: A new adapter MAY delegate to an existing owner, but MUST NOT re-transcribe its formulas, normalization or fallbacks.

contracts.title: No parallel caches
contracts.text: No parallel cache MUST be introduced for data already owned by Portfolio, DXLink, the option-chain cache, the candle store or market context.

contracts.title: No parallel market-data path
contracts.text: No second path MUST be introduced for SPY, VIX, option quotes, option Greeks, beta or underlying spot.

contracts.title: Extension before replacement
contracts.text: When a partial owner exists, the default decision MUST be EXTEND, not NEW.

contracts.title: Existing tests remain authoritative
contracts.text: Future implementations MUST continue to pass the tests of every reused owner.

contracts.title: No ownership by filename assumption
contracts.text: The name of a new file MUST NOT be decided before the ownership audit.

contracts.title: Reuse evidence
contracts.text: Every REUSE or EXTEND decision MUST state definition, callers, tests, units, dependencies and the reason for the choice.

contracts.title: Canonical transport
contracts.text: The future Stress Test client MUST use the existing canonical backend transport (ttCall).

contracts.title: No new direct fetch
contracts.text: The Stress Test client MUST NOT contain a new direct fetch when ttCall or the canonical client can perform the request.

contracts.title: Reuse the transport policy
contracts.text: Authentication, API key, session ID, timeout policy, JSON parsing and error classification MUST be reused.

contracts.title: Budget as owner extension
contracts.text: Any different timeout budget MUST be implemented as an explicit extension of the transport owner, never as a parallel client.

contracts.title: Canonical SPY origin
contracts.text: Every run MUST start from the SPY price already resolved by the canonical Portfolio path.

contracts.title: No second SPY resolver
contracts.text: A second SPY resolver MUST NOT be created.

contracts.title: Frozen SPY snapshot fields
contracts.text: A run MUST freeze spySnapshotPrice, spyPriceSource, spyPriceTimestamp and snapshotCreatedAt.

contracts.title: Percentage shock
contracts.text: stressedSpyPrice = spySnapshotPrice x (1 + spyReturn).

contracts.title: Absolute target
contracts.text: impliedSpyReturn = targetSpyPrice / spySnapshotPrice - 1.

contracts.title: Missing SPY never becomes zero
contracts.text: A missing or stale SPY price MUST produce DEGRADED or UNAVAILABLE, never zero.

contracts.title: Real selected portfolio
contracts.text: The baseline MUST be the portfolio actually selected.

contracts.title: Canonical scope helpers
contracts.text: The canonical scope and active-leg filtering helpers MUST be reused.

contracts.title: Terminal legs contribute zero
contracts.text: Closed, rolled, terminal and quantity-zero legs MUST contribute zero.

contracts.title: Other portfolios excluded
contracts.text: Positions belonging to other portfolios MUST be excluded.

contracts.title: Immutable input
contracts.text: The Actual Portfolio input MUST be immutable.

contracts.title: No second Portfolio rule set
contracts.text: A second, Stress-Test-specific set of Portfolio rules MUST NOT be created.

contracts.title: Canonical builder
contracts.text: The backend MUST reuse the existing canonical option-symbol builder.

contracts.title: No second formatter
contracts.text: A second formatter for root, expiry, type or strike MUST NOT be created.

contracts.title: Dotted roots preserved
contracts.text: Dotted roots such as BRK.B MUST preserve canonical semantics.

contracts.title: Exact contract identity
contracts.text: The exact contract MUST be identified by underlying, expiration, strike and PUT/CALL.

contracts.title: No nearest substitution
contracts.text: A contract MUST NOT be substituted with the nearest strike or the nearest expiry.

contracts.title: One snapshot per run
contracts.text: Actual, Overlay, Proposed and Difference MUST be computed from the same frozen snapshot.

contracts.title: Snapshot identity fields
contracts.text: A snapshot MUST carry snapshotId, snapshotCreatedAt, modelVersion, activePortfolioId, portfolioRevision, positionsHash, spySnapshotPrice, spyPriceSource, spyPriceTimestamp, vixCurrent, vixSource, vixTimestamp, underlyingPrices, optionQuotes, impliedVolatilities, greeks, overlayHash and scenarioHash.

contracts.title: Invalidation
contracts.text: A run MUST be invalidated when the portfolio, a real position, a residual quantity, SPY, VIX, the scenario, the overlay, a strike, an expiry, a side, a contract count, the entry method or the model version changes.

contracts.title: Stale result is announced
contracts.text: An invalidated result MUST be shown as INPUTS CHANGED — RERUN REQUIRED and MUST NOT be silently recomputed or silently displayed as current.

contracts.title: Additive overlay
contracts.text: Proposed = Actual + Overlay. Proposed = Overlay is forbidden.

contracts.title: Leg definition
contracts.text: Every hypothetical leg MUST carry underlying, expiration, strike, optionType, side, contracts and contractMultiplier.

contracts.title: Ephemeral and non-persistent
contracts.text: The overlay MUST NOT modify Portfolio, Journal, the backend trade store, localStorage, orders, real quantities, real legs or any persistent cache.

contracts.title: Signed contracts
contracts.text: signedContracts > 0 for LONG and < 0 for SHORT, applied exactly once together with contractMultiplier.

contracts.title: Entry methods
contracts.text: MARK, MID, BID, ASK and MANUAL MUST be supported and the chosen method MUST be reported with the resulting estimatedEntryPrice, its source and its timestamp.

contracts.title: No double counting
contracts.text: A debit MUST NOT be counted twice, and a credit MUST NOT be declared as initial profit.

contracts.title: Overlay P&L formula
contracts.text: hypotheticalLegStressPnl = (stressedMark - estimatedEntryPrice) x signedContracts x contractMultiplier.

contracts.title: Exact contract hydration
contracts.text: Each exact contract MUST be hydrated at most once per run, deduplicated by canonical symbol, through the existing nested chain, chain cache, coalescer and DXLink quote/Greeks caches.

contracts.title: Provenance
contracts.text: Every hydrated leg MUST return provenance, timestamps and, when unresolved, a missing reason.

contracts.title: Contract not found
contracts.text: A contract that cannot be found MUST yield UNAVAILABLE — exact contract not found.

contracts.title: Independent SPY and VIX inputs
contracts.text: spyReturn (or targetSpyPrice) and vixTarget (or vixChangePct) are distinct inputs. A VIX level MUST NOT automatically imply a single SPY move.

contracts.title: Scenario fields
contracts.text: Every scenario MUST specify spyReturn or targetSpyPrice, vixCurrent, vixTarget or vixChangePct, horizonDays and ivShockMethod.

contracts.title: Presets are illustrative
contracts.text: PURE_VOLATILITY, CORRECTION, STRESS, CRASH and CUSTOM MUST be presented as illustrative hypotheses, never as forecasts.

contracts.title: IV shock methods
contracts.text: DIRECT_IV_SHOCK and VIX_PROXY MUST both be supported and clearly distinguished.

contracts.title: Relative vs points
contracts.text: A relative IV shock and a volatility-points shock MUST be distinct, explicitly labelled modes.

contracts.title: No invented calibration
contracts.text: Historical volatility betas MUST NOT be invented. Without a real calibration the coefficient MUST be configurable, carry provenance, mark the result DEGRADED and allow a manual override.

contracts.title: No hidden clamps
contracts.text: No hidden clamp MUST be applied to a shocked implied volatility. Any bound MUST be declared and reported.

contracts.title: Declared limitations
contracts.text: Unsupported skew and term-structure behaviour MUST be declared as explicit limitations.

contracts.title: Full repricing
contracts.text: The primary pricing MUST be a full repricing. Vega x delta-IV MUST NOT be the primary method; it MAY appear only as secondary diagnostics.

contracts.title: Pricing inputs
contracts.text: Pricing MUST take spot, strike, timeToExpiry, impliedVolatility, riskFreeRate, dividendYield, optionType and exerciseStyle.

contracts.title: American exercise
contracts.text: American-style options MUST support early exercise.

contracts.title: Anchored repricing
contracts.text: stressedMark = currentMarketMark + stressedTheoreticalValue - baseTheoreticalValue.

contracts.title: Pricing ownership
contracts.text: The pricing engine MAY be classified NEW only after the absence proof. If any pricing owner is found it MUST be REUSE or EXTEND.

contracts.title: Pricing is backend-owned
contracts.text: No pricing formula MUST exist in the frontend, and none MUST exist in index.html.

contracts.title: Four result sets
contracts.text: The backend MUST produce actualResult, overlayResult, proposedResult and differenceResult.

contracts.title: Additivity
contracts.text: proposedStressPnl = actualStressPnl + overlayStressPnl within a documented tolerance.

contracts.title: Incremental effect
contracts.text: incrementalEffect = proposedStressPnl - actualStressPnl.

contracts.title: Shared inputs
contracts.text: Actual and Proposed MUST use the same SPY, VIX, scenario, horizon, model, snapshot and sources.

contracts.title: Backend batch matrix
contracts.text: The numerical matrix MUST be computed by the backend in a single batch request containing every scenario.

contracts.title: Frontend renders only
contracts.text: The visual scenario grid MUST remain frontend-owned and MUST NOT compute stress values.

contracts.title: Minimum grid
contracts.text: The minimum matrix is SPY 0%, -5%, -10%, -15%, -20% by VIX current, +50%, +100%, +200%.

contracts.title: Cell fields
contracts.text: Each cell MUST carry scenarioId, spyReturn, stressedSpyPrice, vixTarget, actualStressPnl, proposedStressPnl, difference, actualStressPnlPctNlv, proposedStressPnlPctNlv and status.

contracts.title: No per-cell work
contracts.text: One request per cell, a full pricing loop in the renderer, a fetch per leg per scenario and an option-chain fetch per cell are all forbidden.

contracts.title: Benchmarks required
contracts.text: Benchmarks MUST be defined for 10, 30, 60 and 100 legs against 20 scenarios, measuring elapsed time, CPU, memory, pricing count, provider calls, cache hits, coalesced requests, request bytes, response bytes, cold cache, warm cache, Actual only, Actual + Overlay and the full matrix.

contracts.title: No N+1
contracts.text: No request per position, per leg per scenario or per cell MUST exist, and no option-chain request or quote hydration MUST be repeated for the same exact contract within a run.

contracts.title: Limits derive from measurement
contracts.text: Final performance limits MUST be derived from the benchmarks, not asserted in advance.

contracts.title: Three statuses
contracts.text: Every result MUST carry status VALID, DEGRADED or UNAVAILABLE.

contracts.title: Missing never becomes zero
contracts.text: A missing input MUST NOT be converted into zero.

contracts.title: No silent exclusion
contracts.text: An unavailable leg MUST NOT be silently included or silently dropped.

contracts.title: Incomplete Proposed is not VALID
contracts.text: An incomplete Proposed result MUST NOT be reported as VALID.

contracts.title: Coverage reporting
contracts.text: Legs requested, legs evaluated, legs excluded, reasons, excluded value, sources, timestamps and fallbacks MUST be reported.

contracts.title: Monolith boundary
contracts.text: index.html MUST NOT contain pricing, scenario, matrix, overlay calculations, option-symbol logic, option-chain logic, a SPY resolver, a market-data resolver, stress state, a stress renderer, a stress cache, data-quality rules or contract constants.

contracts.title: Permitted monolith additions
contracts.text: Future runtime PRs MAY add to index.html only a stylesheet link, a script tag, a STRESS TEST navigation entry, an empty mount point and a minimal bootstrap call site.

contracts.title: Specification PR is inert
contracts.text: This specification PR MUST NOT modify index.html, js/** or css/**, MUST NOT add an endpoint, MUST NOT implement behaviour, MUST NOT add persistence and MUST NOT place an order.

forbidden: a full pricing loop in the renderer
a fetch per leg per scenario

overlay.pnlFormula: hypotheticalLegStressPnl = (stressedMark - estimatedEntryPrice) x signedContracts x contractMultiplier

endpointProposal.namingRule: The final name MUST follow the backend's real conventions. Existing portfolio routes use POST /portfolio/<verb-phrase> (live-refresh, technical-refresh, full-refresh) and POST /portfolio/:portfolioId/positions/enriched.
endpointProposal.role: orchestrator composing existing owners; MUST NOT become a second Portfolio backend

openDecisions.question: Does the stress request pass a portfolioId, or a full client-side position snapshot?
openDecisions.evidence: POST /portfolio/live-refresh and POST /portfolio/full-refresh both REQUIRE a client-supplied positions[] array and return 400 'positions required' without it. POST /portfolio/:portfolioId/positions/enriched is the only route that hydrates server-side, via buildPortfolioPositionsFromJournal(portfolioId), falling back to the payload only when the journal has nothing for that id.
openDecisions.implication: The backend DOES own an authoritative portfolio source keyed by portfolioId, so duplicating positions in the request body is avoidable in principle. Whether the journal store is authoritative for every portfolio the UI can select is NOT proven by this audit.

openDecisions.question: Do stress inputs and outputs use raw per-share Greeks or the points-normalized values normalizeGreekPoints produces?
openDecisions.evidence: normalizeGreekPoints (js/utils/normalizers.js:12) multiplies delta and theta by 100 when 0 < |n| <= 1, and leaves gamma and vega untouched. This is a magnitude heuristic, not a declared unit, and it is not idempotent for a true delta of exactly 1.0.
openDecisions.implication: Mixing normalized and raw Greeks between Actual and Overlay would silently break PST-RESULT-002 additivity.

openDecisions.question: What is the exact VIX-to-IV conversion for VIX_PROXY?
openDecisions.evidence: The backend VIX family is delivered in index points (18.0 means 18), while option implied volatilities are decimals (0.18). No conversion or volatility-beta calibration exists anywhere in either repository.
openDecisions.implication: Any VIX_PROXY implementation without a stated conversion and a real calibration must be DEGRADED with a configurable coefficient (PST-IV-003).

openDecisions.question: What does the threshold 'Vega LP / |Vega SP| > 30' mean?
openDecisions.evidence: Recorded verbatim from the requesting specification. It is NOT reinterpreted as 30% by this document.
openDecisions.implication: The ratio could be a pure ratio of 30, a percentage of 30%, or a differently-scaled comparison. Choosing one silently would encode an unapproved threshold.
openDecisions.status: OPEN — SEMANTICS UNDECIDED, MUST NOT BE AUTO-INTERPRETED
openDecisions.mustResolveBefore: any PR that surfaces this ratio

openDecisions.question: Where do riskFreeRate and dividendYield come from?
openDecisions.evidence: Neither value exists as a data source in either repository. `riskFreeRate`, `risk-free` and `discount factor` return zero matches; the only `DividendYield` is a display-only Alpha Vantage fundamental at index.html:15470.
openDecisions.implication: Until a real source exists these are UNAVAILABLE inputs. They must be explicit, configurable run parameters with declared provenance, and a run using a default MUST report which default it used.

openDecisions.question: Where does NLV come from for the %NLV outputs?
openDecisions.evidence: netLiq is fetched from GET /account/:number/balances and rendered at index.html:3749. It is not threaded into any risk computation today.
openDecisions.implication: actualStressPnlPctNlv and proposedStressPnlPctNlv require an explicit NLV input with its own source and timestamp, or they are UNAVAILABLE.

openDecisions.question: What is the documented additivity tolerance for PST-RESULT-002?
openDecisions.evidence: No tolerance is established because no pricing implementation exists yet to measure floating-point drift against.
openDecisions.implication: PR 2 must derive the tolerance from measured behaviour and record it here, rather than asserting one now.

openDecisions.question: Which end of the system freezes the SPY triple (price, source, timestamp) for a run?
openDecisions.evidence: resolveFreshSpyPrice (index.html:19457) ALREADY returns {price, source, isLive, stale, priorityUsed, reason, attempts} with per-attempt records, and resolvePortfolioLivePrice returns the same shape. The provenance therefore already exists in a canonical owner. What is missing is only plumbing: _resolveSpyPrice discards everything except the number, and nothing transmits the triple to the backend.
openDecisions.implication: Either the frontend forwards the frozen triple in the request (a thin EXTEND of an output surface that already computes it), or the backend resolves SPY through its own already-canonical quote path and the frontend consumes THAT. Doing both would create two SPY sources for one run and violate PST-SPY-002. This is a plumbing-direction decision, NOT a licence to write a resolver.

benchmarkPlan.referenceBaseline: POST /portfolio/live-refresh executes one batch request per 60s refresh cycle with zero per-leg and zero per-cell requests. The stress endpoint must not regress from that shape.
